visual_goal: Show Corvane's 2027 baseline: Roomstead copies room-type truth from hotels through Switchyard into Tally and Pricegrid, Nookaway holds one calendar per home in Almanac and exchanges iCal with other platforms, and only Corvane Payments and group finance sit beneath both.
prompt: A landscape systems illustration with two side-by-side panels above one shared base. Left panel, soft blue, labeled 'Roomstead' at its top: inside it, three boxes stacked top to bottom and joined by downward arrows: a gateway box 'Switchyard', a database cylinder 'Tally', and a cache box with a lightning icon 'Pricegrid'. Above the left panel, a small generic hotel building labeled 'Hotels', with one arrow down into 'Switchyard', marked 'ARI'. Right panel, soft teal, labeled 'Nookaway' at its top: inside it, one large calendar page labeled 'Almanac'. Above the right panel, a small house with a person icon labeled 'Hosts', with one arrow down into 'Almanac'. To the right of the right panel, a cluster of plain generic boxes labeled 'Other platforms', joined to 'Almanac' by one double-headed dashed arrow labeled 'iCal'. Beneath both panels, one wide orange base block labeled 'Corvane Payments', receiving one short arrow straight down from the bottom of the Roomstead panel and one short arrow straight down from the bottom of the Nookaway panel. Under the base, one arrow down to a small grey block labeled 'Group finance'. No arrow crosses a panel it does not belong to.
alt: Roomstead lane with hotels feeding Switchyard, Tally and Pricegrid; Nookaway lane with hosts feeding the Almanac calendar, which exchanges iCal with other platforms; both lanes sit on Corvane Payments and group finance.

visual_goal: Show One Stay as layers: two brand products on top, one shared contract layer in the middle, separate supply engines beside one shared platform layer at the bottom.
prompt: A layered architecture illustration drawn as a three-tier stack. Top tier: two separate rounded blocks side by side, a blue one labeled 'Roomstead' and a teal one labeled 'Nookaway', each with one arrow pointing down into the middle tier. Middle tier: one single wide green band spanning the full width, labeled 'Shared contracts', drawn like a connecting plate with plug sockets. Bottom tier, left half: two separate narrow blocks side by side, labeled 'Tally' and 'Almanac', each with one arrow coming down from the green band, and a small caption above them 'separate engines'. Bottom tier, right half: one wide orange foundation block labeled 'Shared group platforms', with one arrow coming down from the green band.
alt: A three-tier stack: Roomstead and Nookaway on top, one shared contracts band in the middle, and below it separate Tally and Almanac engines beside one block of shared group platforms.
